name: Kigoma

queries.query: Kigoma Tanzania official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Ministry of Lands e-Ardhi system, its public map/service application, and an official Ministry report stating that e-Ardhi implementation in Kigoma uploaded and approved 4,851 plots. No anonymous Kigoma parcel feature was established from discovery alone.

queries.query: Kigoma Tanzania ramani kadastre viwanja mfumo taarifa ardhi serikali
queries.result: Utafutaji wa vyanzo vya serikali kwa Kiswahili ulipata mfumo rasmi wa e-Ardhi na taarifa ya Wizara kuhusu viwanja 4,851 vya Tabora na Kigoma vilivyopandishwa na kuhidhinishwa. Hakuna jibu la wazi la kiwanja chenye kitambulisho na jiometri lililopatikana bila mipaka ya uthibitisho.

officialSources.observation: Official Ministry of Lands e-Ardhi application. The current JavaScript configuration exposed the public GeoServer base https://eardhi.lands.go.tz/map/geoserver/taspro and a map/service workflow; no login or private token was used.

Official Ministry news page reports e-Ardhi implementation in Kigoma and Tabora, including 4,851 plots uploaded and approved. It is evidence of ministry/local service activity, not proof of complete city coverage or open parcel geometry.
Official Kigoma regional government page; used as local administrative context. It did not expose a parcel feature service in this bounded attempt.

requests.outcome: Viewer shell loaded. Current JavaScript was inspected and exposed SERVER_URL https://eardhi.lands.go.tz/gw and GEOSERVER_API https://eardhi.lands.go.tz/map/geoserver/taspro.
WMS capabilities returned 322,380 bytes. It established the public map service and layer catalogue; no parcel geometry was retained from WMS.
WFS 2.0 capabilities returned 134,321 bytes and listed taspro:spatial_units plus other survey/town-plan layers.

Schema returned. taspro:spatial_units is a polygon-like parcel/spatial-unit layer with native long id, native string uid, and gml MultiSurface geom; many additional source fields were observed but not retained.

requests.method: GET; anonymous; bounded exact-point query; request coordinates in longitude/latitude order
requests.outcome: GeoJSON response was usable but returned zero features. This exact-point zero result is not treated as citywide absence and no sample was retained.

requests.method: GET; anonymous; bounded approximately 20 m box; TLS verification enabled
requests.outcome: Timed out after 30 seconds with no response. No retry with credentials, private token, TLS disablement, or unsafe fields was attempted. Timeout is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

The published official URL could not be fetched by local curl because the certificate did not match lands.go.tz. No certificate exception was used; search-indexed first-party content was recorded separately.

registryBasis: Official Ministry of Lands e-Ardhi and Ministry reporting establish Tanzania's land-service/cadastral custodian and documented Kigoma plot-service activity. The public GeoServer exposes a spatial-unit layer, but city-bounded coverage and a successful Kigoma parcel feature response were not verified.

nativeFieldMapping.note: Schema metadata only; no feature row was retained. Do not treat internal response order as identity.

crs: WFS schema/service queried with srsName=EPSG:4326; source native CRS was not independently established from a feature response.
geometryQuality: not evaluated; no parcel geometry retrieved
verifiedParcelResponse: Exact-point GeoJSON response was valid but empty; broader bounded query timed out.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Tanzania Ministry of Lands e-Ardhi public land-service/map infrastructure and Kigoma plot-service activity.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public WMS/WFS catalogue and spatial_units schema; Kigoma citywide parcel coverage, stable feature identity in a returned row, and usable polygon geometry were not verified.

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [-4.88342756153032, 29.6523006847059] was preserved and not shifted; the WFS request used longitude/latitude order internally.
The exact-point zero result and bounded-query timeout are not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
Official ministry reporting of 4,851 Kigoma/Tabora plots does not establish Kigoma city boundaries or complete coverage.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, legal-title or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No raw source-specific attribute set, synthetic identity, or GeoJSON sample was retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only, not source integration or adapter admission; runtime remains held pending serial review.
uncertainty: The public e-Ardhi service is real and its current configuration exposes a WFS schema, but anonymous feature retrieval is slow/partial at this location. Kigoma-specific layer coverage, native identity semantics, source CRS, and citywide completeness remain unresolved.
